lastCompletedStory.title: Verify Node tarball sha256 against SHASUMS256.txt with retrying curls

nextStoryContext: US-001 was the only story in this PRD (single-file change). The Node install RUN block in .devcontainer/Dockerfile now downloads the tarball to its bare filename node-v${NODE_VERSION}-linux-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz (cwd, not /tmp), also downloads SHASUMS256.txt with the same retry flags, greps the one line matching that bare filename anchored at end-of-line, and pipes it into `sha256sum -c -` before the tar extract. Both curls now carry --retry 5 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 2 alongside --fail. Verified end-to-end with `bun scripts/test-in-container.ts`, which triggered a real Dockerfile-mtime-driven rebuild (ensure-container.ts image-stale branch) and ran the full in-container test suite (4494 pass / 0 fail / 28 skip) against the newly-verified toolchain. No further stories pending in prd.json beyond this one at time of writing.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed bare-filename, two-space-separated <sha256>  <filename> line format matching the grep+sha256sum -c approach implemented.
